title: pyproject.toml mypy exclude has invalid regex pattern
context: uv run mypy apps/backend/app/ errors with: The exclude **/__pycache__ is an invalid regular expression, because: nothing to repeat at position 0. Pattern was set in Phase 0 (T-004). Blocks CI mypy gate.
evidence: Command output captured in session log. mypy 1.x expects glob patterns or proper regex with anchors.
impact: Need to fix exclude patterns: replace **/__pycache__ with __pycache__/ (no **/). Or use [[tool.mypy.overrides]] with files = [...]. Tracked in new ticket T-091.

title: F-001 resolved: mypy exclude regex fixed in T-091
context: F-001 found invalid regex pattern in [tool.mypy] exclude (**/__pycache__).
fix: Replaced with __pycache__ (mypy 1.x treats exclude as regex, not glob). Verified: uv run mypy apps/backend/app/ now runs without the regex error.

title: make api-gen broken — references missing scripts/export_openapi.py and check_openapi.py
context: Makefile targets api-gen (line 130) and api-check (line 136) both reference scripts/{export,check}_openapi.py inside apps/backend/, but these files were never created. Discovered while trying to run api-gen after adding GET /api/v1/models endpoint in T-021.
evidence: $ make api-gen → /home/maxbogus/Repositories/hackathon/.venv/bin/python3: can't open file '/home/maxbogus/Repositories/hackathon/apps/backend/scripts/export_openapi.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory. Same for check_openapi.py.
impact: Frontend can't regenerate TS types via make fe-gen (downstream). Workaround: generate openapi.json manually via `uv run python -c 'from app.main import create_app; ...'`. New ticket needed: T-022b or T-NNN to create export_openapi.py and check_openapi.py. RICE ~3 (tooling debt).

title: T-042 and T-091 marked status:done but never git-mv'd to archive/
context: HANDOFF.md 'Что сделано' section lists T-042 and T-091, but docs/backlog/archive/ contains only 23 files (T-001..T-014, T-019..T-021, T-023..T-025, T-027, T-028, T-031). T-042 (predictions endpoint) and T-091 (mypy regex fix) are missing from archive despite being marked done in archive/T-023/.../T-028 references.
evidence: $ ls docs/backlog/archive/ | grep -E 'T-04|T-09' → empty. $ git log --oneline | grep -i 'T-042\|T-091' shows commits 134def7 and 68ef1bc which would have moved them. Possibly the git mv was forgotten in earlier sessions.
